__comment: ArborFirmaCraft variant of tfc_strip_logs (this whole datapack loads only when the 'afc' mod is present, see AfcDataPack). AFC woods share TFC's naming (afc:wood/log/<wood>, all four forms) and join #minecraft:logs, so the same template works with the afc:wood/log/ path filter: each AFC log -> its stripped log / wood / stripped wood. Non-existent forms are pruned by MineColonies. Excludes: 'ancient_' = AFC's inaccessible worldgen-only ancient_<wood> logs; and the six resin/special woods that have NO stripped_log/stripped_wood forms (only log + wood) so they can't strip properly (black_oak, gum_arabic, poplar, rainbow_eucalyptus, redcedar, rubber_fig). The remaining ten full-set woods (baobab, cypress, eucalyptus, fig, hevea, ipe, ironwood, mahogany, teak, tualang) all strip to their own stripped log / wood / stripped wood.
